title: Land Navigation Basics
subtitle: A short grounded lesson with a knowledge check
summary: Covers pace count, terrain association, and resection at an introductory level.

lessons.text: A pace count is the number of paces it takes you to walk 100 meters. Calibrate it on known-distance ground and recount after significant elevation change.
Terrain association is navigating by matching the map's terrain features to what you see, rather than relying only on azimuth and distance.

quiz.stem: What does a pace count measure?

options: Matching map features to the ground
